title: Verify: loadManifestWithFallback unit tests
summary: Unit tests for fallback loading with temp dir
description: Test missing-file reporting and non-throwing fallback using a temp directory.
acceptance_criteria: Bad manifest yields empty manifest and errors
technical_constraints: Filesystem limited to os.tmpdir temp dir

steps.action: Using mkdtempSync like game/tests/manifestLoader.test.ts L23-L31: (1) manifest with assets a.svg (file written) and b.svg (not written): expect manifest.assets ids ['a'], missing [{id:'b',path:'b.svg'}], fallbackAssetId FALLBACK_ASSET_ID; (2) nonexistent manifest path: expect assets [] and errors.length 1, no throw; (3) invalid JSON: same; (4) all files present: missing [].
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/manifestFallback.test.ts
